decisions.reason: The IMU module sits squarely in the firm's modular sensor platform, and its in-house hardware, firmware and API expertise lets it read early demand and improve the module at low cost.
The industrial AC voltage input module draws on established measurement and power know-how and supports the strategic push into industrial and energy-management applications.
As a close extension of the existing relay peripherals, the solid state relay module is fully understood by the firm and cheap to maintain within the building-block system.
The RGB LED control module reuses the firm's existing controller and driver knowledge, so it adds breadth to the modular system at little cost while the firm learns from its first results.
The remote access service for wallboxes builds on the firm's charging and networked-controller expertise and directly supports its strategic expansion into managed charging and energy management.
